description:
What happens when Rayman gets a steering wheel? 

We’re about to find out!

@RaymanGame is landing in #TheCrewMotorfest tomorrow!

About The Crew Motorfest:
Welcome to Motorfest! Discover the evergreen festival featuring the best experiences car culture has to offer. Complete your ultimate action driving bucket list through a series of tailor-made races, themed events, and other unique challenges. Explore the vibrant island of O’ahu in Hawaii alone or with your crew. Whatever the way you enjoy cars and driving, there is something in there for you!

Crimson Waters call captains back to sea.
 
In this new season, the Junk rises in fire, battles become deadlier, and a looming threat awakens within the Abyss.
 
Watch the season launch trailer.

NOTE: The trailer incorrectly lists the Seasonal Perk "ARCBUSTER ORDER" and instead should be listed as "STORMBLAZE ORDER"

About Skull and Bones:
Skull and Bones is an open‑world naval action RPG where no one rules the sea. Ship combat, build choice, and sailing skill define your legend. Play solo or team up with two friends to conquer rival ships and mythical beasts in a vast ocean of up to 20 players.
